reason: Adds a client-side floating question-history panel that lists visible user questions in the current session and scrolls the conversation to a selected question.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示当前会话的问题历史面板，并支持点击问题跳转到对应的对话位置。
summaries.en: Adds a floating question-history panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and lets users jump to the selected question in the conversation.

capabilities: Displays a floating panel of user questions from the current conversation session
Jumps the transcript to a selected question
